चिल् {c6c} P. (चिलति) To put on
clothes.

चिल्ल् {c1c} P. (चिल्लति, चिल्लित)
1 To
become loose, be slack or flaccid.
--2 To act wantonly, sport.

चिलमी(मि)लिका

of necklace.
--2 A fire-fly.
--3
Lightning.

चिल्ल a. [चिल्ल्-अच्] Blear-eyed.
--ल्लः
1 A bleared or sored eye.
--2
The (Bengal) kite; चिल्ला also in
this sense; बंधनभ्रष्टो गृहकपोतश्चिल्लाया
मुखे पतितः

; cf. English
“From the frying-pan into the fire”.
--Comp.
--आभः a petty thief, a
pickpocket.
